messages.author: be6024b785b6a9c1
messages.subject: Shapefiles, holes, and work arounds
parts:
I want to use ggplot to plot shapefiles, but the polygons have holes.
If plotted blindly the hole gets filled with the surrounding area
color occasionally hiding a region underneath.

I found some discussion of this here,
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/92bdd82c535aca12/101e59235dfe93b3?hl=en&lnk=gst&q=esri+shapefile#101e59235dfe93b3,
but the suggestion there is to use fortify.

fortify() in ggplot2 uses gpclib which is for non-commercial use only
so won't work for me. There was also a suggestion to use PBSmapping
findPolys to attach the holes to the outer boundary which should allow
the region to be properly filled.

Does anyone have an example of calling readShapeSpatial with the
findPolys function ? It seems non-trivial to even set this up.

Thanks
